title: Natural-gas inputs declared in m3 where every provider is Nm3
observation: 40 consumer exchanges declare `m3` where every provider of the name declares `Nm3` (DZ/NG/QA/US at production, NO/NL/GB offshore, DE/RU/NL onshore, three RER pipelines, LNG DZ to FR). Amounts are consistent with Nm3 (≈36 MJ per m3); relabel, no rescale.
method: Re-measured on the release files on 2026-10-21; a release-wide scan found no further m3/Nm3 mismatches (apart from the #28 kWh/MJ edge and p/unit spellings). Sibling gas-turbine datasets take 0.027778 Nm3/MJ from the same provider, so the m3 rows already carry Nm3 amounts.

next.action: Send to BAFU with the next batch: relabel the 40 exchanges as Nm3, no rescale.
